prompts.sludge_matte_selected: Create ONE isolated game scenery object: a very small, flat, crusty patch of filthy sewer sediment and oily mud, dull dark brown and grey olive green. Top-down orthogonal square-grid dungeon game, hand painted simplified gritty 2D sprite, strong readable silhouette, short dark contour, no perspective. Intended final size 96 by 64 pixels. A squat irregular puddle with a few solid crust clumps and dark wet interior, compact complete silhouette centered with at least 15 percent empty transparent margin on ALL sides. No long tail, no pouring stream, no surrounding floor. STRICT: absolutely no emissive color, no glowing edge, no light bloom, no yellow halo, no fog or haze, no lighting outside the silhouette, no cast shadow outside object, no text. This is matte non-luminous dirt, not magic. Output transparent alpha outside the crisp physical silhouette. All edges whole, no cropping.
prompts.entry: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated transparent 2D game scenery sprite, review EG-ENT-01 for Project RL. Draw ONE complete open sewer access hatch, with the heavy rectangular metal cover hinged and folded back towards the TOP of the image and a dark square opening below it, two visible ladder rungs descending inside. Industrial futuristic prison district after an apocalypse: tarnished grey steel, chipped dull blue-grey paint, rust confined to seams, worn bolts, a small unlit amber safety lens on its side. MATCH the existing Project RL camp aesthetic: orthographic square grid seen from above, horizontal and vertical parallel axes, modest short visible front wall faces, hand-painted stylized game volumes, nuanced dark contours, matte dirty materials, restrained detail readable at native size. NOT isometric, no diamond grid, no frontal building elevation, no exaggerated aerial perspective. Intended native canvas 96 by 128 pixels; physical ground opening approximately one 64px square cell, cover folds into the cell north of it. Show the whole complete object with transparent margin around ALL sides. The hatch frame and opening have plausible connected geometry and a real ladder, no floating parts. No surrounding pavement, no neighbouring buildings, no scenery, no floor tile, no people, no labels or text, no symbols, no glow or painted light pool. True transparent background. This is an asset to place on the existing street, not an illustration of a street.
prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless square floor-material texture for a native64 orthographic 2D grimdark futuristic sewer dungeon in Project RL. A continuous expanse of old matte concrete and worn stone paving, low-saturation grey-brown, broad restrained hand-painted masses, damp dark stains, edges rubbed smooth, only occasional broken or nearly erased slab joints. Very understated large slabs; NOT a precise repeated square grid, no little lines scratched inside every slab, NO grass tufts, no outlined bricks, no prominent cracks tiled symmetrically. Uniform flat overhead texture, no perspective, no objects, no shadows cast by objects, no walls, no border or frame, no text. No central composition; edges tile seamlessly on both axes. Similar visual weight to the approved dirty Project RL prison street pavement, with simplified textures, nuanced dark outlines only where meaningful, a restrained readable 2D game finish rather than photographic noise. It will be reduced to a 256x256 native patch covering 4x4 cells, so keep detail broad and calm. Full opaque square texture, no transparency and no painted lighting or bloom.
prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE seamless square overhead 2D game texture of dark sewer water, for Project RL native64 tiles. Opaque surface of stagnant filthy water with a barely moving slow current, muted nearly-black olive-grey with a few low-contrast brownish slicks and broad broken ripples. Restrained hand-painted stylized game material, matte and readable at 64 px; match a grimdark abandoned futuristic municipal sewer. The surface is dark and dirty but must still read as WATER; sparse soft narrow reflections and eddies, not a stone floor, no bubbles pattern repeated everywhere. Entire image is only water with no banks, no concrete, no pipes, no trash, no objects, no creatures, no lighting hotspot or luminous green, no border or text. True flat overhead texture, axes parallel, NO perspective or visible horizon. The four edges must tile seamlessly, with no focal point. Intended native tile patch 256x256 covering 4x4 64px cells. Do not add neon poison effects; this is ordinary sewage. It will receive computed lighting in the game and a subtle animated UV current.
prompts.wall: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE seamless square masonry material texture for walls of a native64 2D top-down sewer game. Project RL futuristic grimdark industrial sewers: old grey desaturated stone blocks and stained structural concrete, broad hand-painted planar masses, subtle water stains and occasional rusty iron traces in seams. A consistent worn municipal construction, slightly green-grey and dirty charcoal in recesses. Not medieval ornate stonework. Approximately 4 to 6 large irregular blocks across the image. Softly irregular partially erased mortar joints, varied edge wear, no thick black outlines around every block, no perfectly repeated new bricks, no photographic micro-grain. Keep the values restrained and the wall texture visually quieter than living characters. This texture will be mapped onto separately defined short horizontal/vertical wall meshes with connected corner and T junction geometry; do NOT draw any wall scene, corner, room, floor, perspective, decorative object, pipes, lamp or shadow into the image. Flat unlit material only, seamless all four edges, no border, no letters. Native material patch 256x256, physical game grid 64px. No bloom, no painted lighting pool.
prompts.grate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE complete isolated square industrial metal grating floor panel, transparent background, for Project RL native64 sewer walkway. Orthographic viewed from above on a square grid, edges perfectly horizontal/vertical, NOT isometric and NOT a front elevation. A sturdy dark tarnished steel square outer frame enclosing a practical dense mesh of crossed metal bars, four small bolted corners, worn matte grey metal with restrained rust around joints. True transparent holes BETWEEN the bars so sewer water can be seen below. Whole complete panel visible with a little transparent safety margin on all sides. Broad enough bar thickness to remain readable at a native size of 64x64 pixels, a few well-placed highlights and nuanced dark contours. Comparable finish to a worn futuristic prison service hatch. No floor, no water, no buildings or other objects, no light source, no glow, no logo, no text, no object shadow beyond its own few-pixel contact rim. It is a flat modular bridge deck panel that can be placed edge to edge with another complete panel, so no rails, upright posts, steps or diagonal perspective.
prompts.rat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE four-frame running animation strip for ONE small ordinary sewer rat in a native64 top-down 2D game, Project RL. Exactly FOUR equal-width columns in one horizontal row, transparent background, one whole rat in each column. These are four poses of THE SAME rat running toward the RIGHT, same body length, same scale, same head and fur. Alternating fore/hind paws and a slightly flexing thin long tail across the four frames; no major body translation in its column. True overhead game camera with only a subtle short side face, square orthographic scene, NOT isometric, not a portrait. Small lean grey-brown city rat, short snout, two rounded ears, ordinary black eye, a pinkish-grey slender complete tail, dirty wet fur simplified into broad dark matte shaded masses. No demonic features, no glowing eyes, no blood, no accessories. It must read at an intended native frame of 20x12 pixels, with the actual full animal including tail only about 18 pixels long: a tiny environmental rat beside a 60px human, not a giant monster. Leave generous transparent padding around each whole rat and keep every tail and paw fully within its own separate column. Absolutely no floor, no shadows detached from the animal, no labels, no frame borders, no numbering. Keep whole silhouettes distinct and consistently centred; do not draw a scene or a pile of rats. FOUR RUN CYCLE POSES, side by side in a single row, true transparent background.
prompts.pipe: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE complete isolated rusted sewer pipe assembly on a true transparent background, for Project RL native64 orthographic 2D grimdark scenery. A thick horizontal industrial pipe with two mounting brackets, two bolted flanges, a small wheel valve and an elbow at the right which turns toward the bottom of the image and ends in a clearly open dark pipe mouth. Intended native canvas 128x64 pixels, total horizontal span 112 pixels, main pipe diameter about 12 pixels, so it remains much smaller than a 60px human in height. Industrial municipal sewers under a ruined futuristic city. Mottled dark orange-brown rust at seams, damp grey-green tarnished steel in surviving patches, grimy matte surfaces, a few peeled paint remnants, broad readable hand-painted shaded volumes and subtle dark contours. Match a top-down orthographic 2D game with square cells and short front faces, straight parallel horizontal/vertical axes, NO isometric diagonal layout, no cinematic perspective or front-elevation composition. The whole assembly and brackets must be complete and self-contained, every part fully inside transparent safety margins. Physically connected pipe bends and solid flanges, no floating parts. Do NOT draw the wall behind it, no floor, no sewage pool, no other scenery, no text or label, no lighting pool or neon glow. The object is to be attached to an existing wall mesh, with its outlet at the room side. Dirty, worn, and uneven, not pristine shiny new plumbing.
prompts.sludge: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated irregular toxic sewage spill decal, true transparent background, for a native64 top-down 2D grimdark futuristic sewer. A squat asymmetric smear of filthy viscous olive-brown liquid with a dark nearly black wet core, a few muted mustard-yellow chemical crust deposits and dirty green sludge at the ragged edges. One narrow trickle enters from the TOP and widens into a low uneven puddle below, so it can sit immediately under a broken wall pipe. Small scraps of dark sludge and at most a few low-contrast bubbles contained within the main spill. Matte and unpleasant, subdued colours, broad readable hand-painted shaded shapes rather than photographic speckles. Intended native footprint 96x64 pixels, low surface thickness, perfectly flat overhead with NO perspective. Show the ENTIRE puddle with a generous transparent margin on ALL sides, softly irregular alpha edge, no straight cropped boundary, no rectangular tile. No pipe itself, no concrete or floor, no other scenery or animals, no symbols, no radioactive icon, no text, no luminous neon glow, no painted light pool. Must look like toxic industrial runoff in a neglected sewer, not bright green fantasy magic.
prompts.sludge_fix: Edit this single sewage-spill asset for production. Keep the dirty olive-brown toxic puddle with mustard chemical crusts, but FIX TWO defects: (1) the narrow incoming trickle is cut off at the top image boundary; shorten that trickle into a complete rounded dried tail and leave at least 12 percent fully transparent empty margin on EVERY side, including above its final tip; (2) REMOVE ALL yellow or green haze, blur, glow, aura and ground shadow around the spill. The alpha outside the PHYSICAL wet liquid and crust must be exactly transparent. No diffuse halo of any kind. This is a flat ground decal that will receive real engine lighting, not a luminous magical puddle. Keep an irregular complete silhouette and a thin flat surface, make the small isolated droplets part of the complete physical silhouette, preserve broad readable dark dirty material masses. No floor added. No perspective, no text. Every liquid edge including the tail must be fully visible and fully inside the image. True transparent background.
prompts.stairs: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE complete narrow industrial access staircase leading UP out of a sewer, isolated transparent 2D game scenery sprite. Project RL native64 orthographic square-grid game, camera seen from above with modest short front faces, straight parallel axes, NO isometric diamond grid or cinematic perspective. A compact flight of 7 or 8 worn dark grey metal steps goes towards the TOP of the image and ends at a little open square access hatch with its lid folded back; this is an UPWARD stair from an underground room to the street hatch above. Two thin rusted side rails and structural brackets support the stairs. Chipped dull grey-green paint and old rust at joints, damp grime, broad hand-painted readable masses, nuanced dark contours; match a grimdark futuristic municipal sewer. Intended native canvas 80x144 pixels, physical flight about one 64px cell wide and two cells long; the whole complete stair and hatch must fit, with transparent safety margins. No surrounding room, no floor slab, no wall facade, no characters, no signage or lettering, no labels, no giant fantasy gate, no light pool or glowing effects. The structural geometry must be coherent, connected steps and railings, no floating rungs, all elements entirely in frame. It must read as a walkable metal stair going up at native size.
